decisions.reason: This program is only lightly publicized and appears partly substitutable with the firm's stronger express offers, so despite some process investment management can justify withdrawing it as a consolidation step.
A 72-hour express offer supports the firm's fast-response service promise and, as a recent launch, disappointing early uptake can still be attributed to ramp-up and capacity-adjustment effects.
The fire-resistant steel exterior door is highly visible, certification-intensive, and tightly aligned with the firm's core safety-led direction, which makes management strongly inclined to persist.
This express program has a dedicated page and sits close to the established business, so public commitment and strategic fit both favor continuation.

The online ordering and digital services platform reflects a visible strategic move toward deeper advisory and service support, and initial weaknesses can readily be framed as temporary adoption issues.
A fire and smoke protection door is central to the firm's compliance and safety proposition, so management is likely to continue backing it even if early results are mixed.
